digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (orchestrator, det_floor.py, passes.py, criteria_routing.json, review_kernel)
propositions: Integrate seven decomposition recommendations (R1-R7) from task-decomposition SOTA report into plan-review gate with eval-based validation (E1/E2/E3/E5/E6), advisory-first posture where batch-evals deferred, and standing dogfood monitoring via d8a5's criterion_effectiveness.py

R1/R3/R4 ship in advisory (never-blocking) posture after bounded sanity checks, auto-monitored by standing effectiveness recorder, with advisory-to-blocking promotion gate documented in docs/plan-review-gate.md

E1 outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) frozen and committed; E1's finding-adjudication/inter-rater-κ corpus descoped (tool-less labeling ~79% contaminated); E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baseline permanently rejected on cost, superseded by zero-LLM sidecar d8a5

R2 (operator-attested DET lint) extends p6_ac_quality in det_floor.py with no criteria_routing.json file conflict; R3/R4/R5 coordinate through criteria_routing.json/review_kernel serialization after floor-split story to avoid conflicts

All landed criteria enter packaged registry directly (no config-flag), with R7 instrumentation measuring blocking-FP-proxy (fraction of blocking findings adjudicated false-positive); demotion threshold 10% triggers advisory demotion via ordinary criteria_routing.json change

Plan-review methodology updated in docs/plan-review-gate.md; no A/B testing; validation is eval-based pre-ship (advisory-safety) or standing dogfood post-ship; operator-approved pivots: batch-eval→advisory-first, E2/E3 batch-baseline deferral, κ descope
